# Precision and observability before reusable computation

Date: 2026-10-31. Working mathematical result for the Astra construction task.
This note derives an information lower bound and a constructive task-directed
escape. It does not claim literature novelty. The main proof is elementary
indistinguishability plus a spherical small-cap bound. The comparison section
identifies existing machinery relevant to stronger positive constructions.

## 1. Exact contract

Let n >= 2 and 0 < a <= 1 be known. Work initially over R^n. The unknown,
fixed positive-definite matrix belongs to

    C = {I} union {A_u = I + a u u^T : ||u||_2 = 1}.

Every matrix in C has condition number at most 2. A_u generates an exact
unital algebra of dimension 2 (the identity matrix generates dimension 1).
Thus neither a large exact algebra nor an ill-conditioned downstream problem
causes the lower bound below.

An experiment requests a vector v and an accuracy sigma > 0, and receives

    y = A v + e,        ||e||_2 <= sigma ||v||_2.

Errors may be deterministic, query-dependent, correlated across experiments,
and chosen adversarially subject to this bound. The matrix A is fixed before
the algorithm's random coins. This is a contract on each action, not a promise
that all errors are generated by a single small-norm linear perturbation.

The learner chooses v and sigma adaptively and eventually produces a
source-free compiled map F. For a requested relative solve accuracy epsilon,
its required event is

    for every later b: ||F(b) - A^{-1} b||_2 <= epsilon ||A^{-1}b||_2.

The map can use ordinary arithmetic and retained data, but cannot consult the
source after b is provided. We require the event to have probability at least
1-delta for every A in C and every admissible source-error rule. Assume

    0 < delta < 1/2,        0 < epsilon < a/(a+2).

For example a=1, epsilon=1/4 is allowed, while all matrices remain between I
and 2I in Loewner order. Acquisition failure, unsuccessful probes and precision
charges count. No representation of u is supplied.

## 2. A single fixed source-error rule

For each u define the following oracle, for every v and requested sigma:

    O_{u,sigma}(v)
      = A_u v - clip(a u^T v, -sigma||v||, sigma||v||) u.

1. THE QUESTION AND THE CHANGE OF CONTRACT

The target is a continuing stream of reliable, full-vector linear solves and
convex response-design computations for an unknown fixed Hermitian operator
family. Experiments return imperfect chosen vector actions. The learner must
construct its own retained representation and solver.

We do not attempt to recover the exact generated algebra. We do not claim that
one finite approximate closure can answer all rational expressions. We retain
the exact-algebra compiler and its trace theorem at the scope given in the
user's prompt; this construction supplies a different computational service.

The source remains available. A previously unseen task direction can require a
new experiment. A successful task is returned only with a residual certificate
covering the current source uncertainty. A failed task supplies an additional
operator-action direction, retained for future tasks. This is an explicit
exchange of universal offline identification for continuing task-triggered
measurement, not a claim of free source-free deployment.

The principal theorem is an end-to-end synthesis of established Galerkin,
residual, greedy-width and recycling tools. Its potentially useful content is
the combined acquisition/certification/lifetime/precision statement below.
Historical originality and practical superiority are not established.

Scientific conclusion and executed results, 31 October 2026

MAIN CONCLUSION

The strongest completed construction is a continuing, task-triggered solver.
It learns a reusable subspace of actual operator actions, constructs a small
Galerkin solver, and returns each answer with an explicit residual bound that
includes the retained experimental error. When the learned object is inadequate,
the failed solve produces a quantitatively separated new direction to retain.

At a fixed accuracy/coercivity scale, a numerical-width hypothesis bounds the
TOTAL number of such learning events over an arbitrarily long adaptive task
stream. Exact algebra closure, a useful basis, exact solution snapshots, and a
global worst-task search are not supplied. Generic full-rank perturbations are
allowed. The source remains available; novel task directions can still require
an action measurement. This continuing-access contract is essential.

This is a constructive robust computation result assembled from established
numerical machinery. It is not yet a civilisation-changing advance. The
strongest ordinary comparator tested ties it on source-action count, and
historical novelty/practical superiority have not been established.

THE COMPLETED MATHEMATICAL SERVICE

Unknown fixed Hermitian primitives B_j are accessed through imperfect full-vector
actions with norm error at most d||v|| at the actually requested tolerance d.
The later tasks solve

    [alpha I + sum theta_j B_j] x=b,
    sum |theta_j|<=1,
    alpha I+sum theta_j B_j >= mu I,

to relative Euclidean solution error epsilon. The source bound mu>0 is warranted;
it is not inferred from the reduced model. For a positive quadratic combination
of the original Hermitian sources, B_j=A_j^2 can be constructed using two
imperfect source actions, and a chosen alpha>0 supplies mu=alpha.

action image at distance greater than g=tau-2sigma from the retained space.
